name: VowelFilter
descr: Filter the erroneous F1/F2 formant values of a set of files. The distributions of the duration, F1 and F2 values are estimated on all the given files, for each vowel class and each estimation method, then the values too far from the expected ones are discarded. Each file must contain the speech of one speaker only, in one speech activity only and at least 3 occurrences of each vowel. Proposed by M. Lancien et al. 2023.

options.text: Pattern of the input file with F1 and F2 values.

Pattern of the output file with the filtered F1 and F2 values.
Maximum number of standard deviations between a token and the mean values of its class.
Minimum number of occurrences a vowel class requires to estimate its distribution. At least 2.
